form.label: Audit Review
form.description: Current pass, partial, fail, and not-assessed status by requirement.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected_value=tostring(coalesce(selected,default_selected)), selected=if(selected_value="1" OR selected_value="true",1,0) | search status=active selected=1 | fields framework_key framework_name
| inputlookup ccp_systems | search status=active | sort system_name | fields system_key system_name

| `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_latest_assessments` | where "$system_token$"="*" OR system_key="$system_token$" | fields framework_key requirement_key system_key status score assessor assessed_at reviewer reviewed_at notes] | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| `ccp_evidence_rollup` | where "$system_token$"="*" OR system_key="$system_token$" | fields framework_key requirement_key system_key evidence_count] | eval status=coalesce(status,"Not assessed"), evidence_count=coalesce(evidence_count,0) | lookup policy_playbook.csv framework_key requirement_key OUTPUT implementation_title owner_role

div.p: Use the latest recorded assessment for each requirement. Not assessed is intentionally visible and never treated as pass.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_assessment_profiles.csv | lookup framework_catalog.csv framework_key OUTPUT framework_name version | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | table framework_name version assessment_granularity assessment_methods scoring_model required_artifacts audit_boundary | rename framework_name as Framework version as Version assessment_granularity as "Assessment level" assessment_methods as "Assessment methods" scoring_model as "Decision model" required_artifacts as "Artifacts expected" audit_boundary as "Audit boundary"
| search status="Partial" OR status="Fail" | stats count

| table requirement_key title category status score evidence_count assessor assessed_at reviewer reviewed_at implementation_title owner_role | rename requirement_key as "Check key" title as Requirement category as Category status as Status score as Score evidence_count as Evidence assessor as Assessor assessed_at as "Assessed at" reviewer as Reviewer reviewed_at as "Reviewed at" implementation_title as "Implementation" owner_role as "Suggested owner"
